replacements.old: - name: Validate exact maintenance target observation evidence
replacements.new:
- name: Validate bulk access role assignment evidence
        id: access-role-bulk-evidence
        timeout-minutes: 1
        if: ${{ success() && matrix.name == 'access' }}
        run: python3 scripts/validate_access_role_bulk_evidence.py --source-root .
      - name: Retain validated bulk access role assignment evidence
        timeout-minutes: 1
        if: ${{ success() && matrix.name == 'access' && steps.access-role-bulk-evidence.outcome == 'success' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: access-role-bulk-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            web/playwright-report/access-role-bulk-validated/access-role-bulk-evidence.json
            web/playwright-report/access-role-bulk-validated/access-role-bulk-users-1440.png
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
      - name: Validate exact maintenance target observation evidence
